purpose: Determine whether official Hyperliquid public documentation or official public source code explicitly identifies the native validator-published oracle update message/schema and its relationship, if any, to the documented historical node-history surfaces. This is source-provenance research only. It cannot substitute for historical bytes, prove historical completeness, or reopen the parent economic replication.
allowed_source_classes: official Hyperliquid documentation on hyperliquid.gitbook.io or docs.hyperliquid.xyz
official public GitHub repositories owned by hyperliquid-dex
frozen_questions: Is the native validator-published oracle update message or action explicitly named or structurally defined in an official public source?
Does an official public source explicitly map that native-oracle message/schema to explorer_blocks, replica_cmds, or another documented historical node-history surface?
Does the public source provide enough ordering/timestamp semantics to define a deterministic historical reconstruction contract in principle, without viewing historical values?
allowed_outputs: field names only where they do not reveal market numeric values
explicit mapping or absence of mapping to official historical node-history surfaces

decision_rule.PASS_PUBLIC_SCHEMA_IDENTITY_ONLY: Official public sources explicitly identify the native validator-oracle message/schema and its mapping to a historical node-history surface with sufficient ordering/timestamp semantics to define a separately frozen reconstruction contract. This still does not prove historical bytes are accessible or complete.
decision_rule.PARTIAL_SCHEMA_IDENTITY_NO_HISTORY_MAPPI: Official public sources identify the native validator-oracle message/schema but do not explicitly map it to the accessible/documented historical node-history surfaces. Historical reconstruction remains unproven.
decision_rule.FAIL_PUBLIC_SCHEMA_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED: Official public sources do not unambiguously identify the required native validator-oracle schema or distinguish it from HIP-3/deployer oracle mechanisms.
decision_rule.TECHNICAL_BLOCKED: Official documentation/repository access or source-version ambiguity prevents complete adjudication.
